svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rail beam: 80 x 40 x 3 mm RHS, 1,540 mm long, stood on its narrow

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge (80 mm tall). The top face is the trolley track: keep it

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: clean and free of weld spatter; file any seam bead flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes: two 11 mm vertical holes through both walls at each end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 17.5 and 97.5 mm from the end, on the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Crush tubes: 14 mm tube 74 mm long inside the beam at each hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the through-bolts do not crush it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: each end sits on a post cap, held by two M10 x 110 bolts;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bolt heads on top stop the trolley at the ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the top face is straight within 1 mm over its length
